requirement: v3.5.9 release candidate: dsh-teams must activate without a missing module, resolving defineTool through the shared loader used by the other sub-plugins, and must still mount w2m_team_status, w2m_team_room and w2m_team_artifact.

assertions.failure: Before the fix, enabling dsh-teams failed with Error: Cannot find module '../../lib/tool-kit.js' from src/plugin/teams-plugin.mjs; the file is absent from both the tree and the tarball.
assertions.fix: teams-plugin.mjs now imports loadDefineTool from ./tools/shared.mjs, the same loader p2p-webrtc-plugin and backup-plugin use; createRequire and the lib/tool-kit.js reference were removed.
assertions.regression: A new case mounts the plugin without injecting defineTool and asserts the three tool names are registered; test/teams-plugin.test.mjs: 12 tests, 12 pass, 0 fail.
assertions.claims: After repacking, test/claims.test.mjs: 48 assertions, 47 pass, 1 accepted skip, 0 fail.
assertions.installed_entry: The module at the installed profile path imports cleanly and exposes apply and buildTools as functions after the same file was copied into the installed package.
assertions.subplugins: dsh-desktop, dsh-backup and dsh-backup-plugin remain disabled: true in cordis.patch.yml; the Teams row is opt-in and only mounts when enabled.
